title: Family-wise maximum Top20 hit audit across 42 fixed rule configurations

hypothesis.h0: The per-target maximum Top20 hit count across the fixed 42-rule family is no greater than its conditional uniform 5-of-40 randomization distribution.
hypothesis.h1: The mean per-target maximum Top20 hit count exceeds its conditional randomization expectation in the final chronological Blind OOS segment.
hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Blind OOS mean(M_t) minus its conditional randomization expectation; one-sided positive lift.

design.candidate_family: 42 rule configurations in historical_rule_ledger.csv; the family is fixed per target and the maximum is computed after scoring all 42.
design.null: For each target and each replicate, independently draw one uniform 5-of-40 quintet and score its maximum overlap against that target's same 42 Top20 sets. This conditions on the candidate sets and preserves their overlap/dependence.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of per-target observed maximum minus per-target Monte Carlo null expectation

multiplicity.handling: The maximum over all 42 forecasts is recomputed inside every conditional randomization replicate, so dependence among the 42 candidate sets is preserved and the within-family selection effect is included.
multiplicity.broader_research_family: No correction across the historical Q00-Q128 research family. The source explicitly labels the rows RETROSPECTIVE_WALK_FORWARD_RULE_FIXED_NOW; formula-family selection after seeing the archive remains a material limitation.
multiplicity.holm: Not required for the single preregistered Blind OOS primary endpoint. Discovery and Validation are descriptive.

limitations: The historical Blind OOS segment is not a virgin holdout and has been inspected by earlier SONAR research.
The 42-rule family was fixed after the historical archive was available; strict-prior target features do not make the family selection itself prospective.
The conditional randomization assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 outcomes across targets; the block bootstrap is a separate dependence-robust uncertainty summary.
Monte Carlo p-value resolution is limited by 1000 randomization replicates.
The statistic measures a post-selection maximum across candidate Top20 sets, not the performance of one deployable engine.

source_sha_correction.reason: The original source pin omitted its final hexadecimal character; the corrected 40-character SHA was verified against the base commit Git tree.
